clubs.name: Code & Coffee Society
clubs.description: A friendly space for students who like building things — web apps, robots, or anything with a blinking LED.

clubs.name: Canvas & Clay Art Collective
clubs.description: From life drawing to ceramics, this club is for anyone who wants to make something with their hands.
clubs.meeting: Wednesdays, 5:30 PM — Fine Arts Studio B

clubs.name: Campus Runners Club
clubs.description: Casual to competitive — we run together three times a week and train for the annual campus 10K.
clubs.meeting: Mon/Wed/Fri, 6:30 AM — Meet at the Quad

clubs.name: Debate & Rhetoric Union
clubs.description: Sharpen your argument. We compete in regional debate tournaments and host open-mic argument nights.

clubs.name: Green Campus Initiative
clubs.description: Student-run sustainability projects: campus composting, a community garden, and clean-up drives.
clubs.meeting: First Saturday of the month, 10:00 AM — Community Garden

clubs.name: Acoustic Sessions Music Club
clubs.description: Bring an instrument or just your voice — we jam every week and host an open mic once a semester.

clubs.name: Entrepreneurship Network
clubs.description: A student community for founders and future founders — pitch practice, workshops, and mentor meetups.

clubs.name: International Students Association
clubs.description: Connecting students from around the world with events, language exchanges, and cultural nights.
clubs.meeting: Every other Sunday, 4:00 PM — International Center

clubs.name: Board Game & Strategy Club
clubs.description: Weekly game nights covering everything from classic strategy games to tabletop RPG campaigns.
clubs.meeting: Saturdays, 2:00 PM — Student Center Game Room
